product_family: AI-powered e-commerce personalization platform (Search, Recommendations, Chat, Audience, Email)

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: These Contractual Clauses set out the rights and obligations of the data controller and the data processor, when processing personal data on behalf of the data controller. The Clauses have been designed to ensure the parties' compliance with Article 28(3) of Regulation 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 April 2016 on the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001
certifications.proof_quote: We are compliant with the standards and frameworks listed above, but we are not yet certified by a third-party auditor. We have the intention to seek such certification in 2026.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Formal attestation is pending and we do not yet hold an external SOC 2 report.

certifications.name: EU AI Act
certifications.proof_quote: We are compliant with the standards and frameworks listed above, but we are not yet certified by a third-party auditor. We have the intention to seek such certification in 2026.

privacy.ai_training_note: Clerk.io does not train on individual customer data. Optional AI features (Chat assistance, AI-generated email drafts) send conversation transcripts or message content to OpenAI for LLM processing only; if these features are not enabled, no data is shared with OpenAI. Clerk.io may use data in anonymous or aggregated form for industry trends and statistics. Privacy policy also states each account is stored in separated data store containers.
privacy.data_region: EU only. Primary servers in Germany, backup in Ireland. Danish company (Clerk.io ApS, Copenhagen, VAT: DK33952848) governed by Danish law.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: Yes, TLS 1.3 confirmed in Trust Services Criteria Mapping

security.name: Access controls
security.value: Least-privilege; MFA via Google Workspace SSO

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Regular penetration testing claimed (self-reported); frequency and third-party tester not publicly disclosed

security.name: CI security scanning
security.value: Automated SAST and SCA scans in CI pipeline

security.name: Bug bounty
security.value: Referenced internally in incident response plan (detection via bug bounty channel); no public HackerOne or Bugcrowd program found

security.name: Data isolation
security.value: Each customer account stored in separated data store containers

security.name: Breach notification
security.value: 72-hour regulatory notification; customer notification within 24 hours for major incidents affecting over 5% of customers or involving PII

security.name: Data Subject Rights API
security.value: Privacy Information API and Privacy Forget API available; 30-day SLA for DSAR requests

products.name: Search
products.data_scope: Visitor behavior (page views, clicks, queries), product catalog, sales data. No PII required unless customer is identified.
products.notes: Personalized search using behavioral and purchase intent data. No AI model training on individual customer data.

products.name: Recommendations
products.data_scope: Customer behavioral data, order history, product catalog.
products.notes: Upsell and cross-sell engine; uses Clerk.io's proprietary AI trained on 15 years of e-commerce data. Customer data used for personalization within their own account, not shared across clients.

products.name: Chat
products.data_scope: Conversation transcripts shared with OpenAI for LLM processing when feature is enabled.
products.notes: Powered by OpenAI. Customer must opt in. Conversation content leaves Clerk.io infrastructure and is processed by OpenAI solely for the requested AI functionality. Disable in account settings to prevent data sharing with OpenAI.

products.name: Audience
products.data_scope: Purchase intent signals, behavioral segments, email addresses. Segments exportable to Meta and Google Ads as Lookalike Audiences.
products.notes: Third-party ad platform integration means audience segment data may be shared with Meta/Google when Lookalike Audience export is used.

products.name: Email
products.data_scope: Subscriber list, behavioral data, product catalog. Optional AI email drafts send message content (which may include customer data) to OpenAI.
products.notes: AI-generated email drafts use OpenAI (optional); if not used, no data is shared. Dynamic email content is updated at open-time using behavioral signals.

compare.pricing_model: Subscription, prepaid and billed periodically (monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, or yearly). Free trial available. Excess usage billed automatically. Business entities only.
compare.data_residency: EU only (Germany primary, Ireland backup). No multi-region or US data residency option disclosed.
top_certs: SOC 2 Type II (self-declared, no third-party audit)

flags: ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II are self-declared only: no third-party auditor has issued a certificate or attestation report as of June 2026. Clerk.io states formal certification is planned for 2026.
Privacy policy references the EU-US Privacy Shield, which was invalidated in 2020 by the Schrems II ruling; this is an outdated legal basis for US data transfers.

Optional AI Chat and AI Email features route conversation transcripts and message content to OpenAI. Customers must actively disable these features if OpenAI data sharing is prohibited under their own compliance requirements.
Audience product exports segments to Meta and Google Ads. Customers using Lookalike Audience export should verify their own DPA and consent obligations with those ad platforms.
Bug bounty program exists internally per incident response documentation but no public platform (HackerOne or Bugcrowd) listing was found. Scope and rewards are not publicly disclosed.
